# mistershell_note (Data Source)

Reads MisterShell note through the authenticated API. Permissions and scope are enforced by the server.

Requires MisterShell >= 2.1.0.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mistershell_note" "example" {
  scope_type = "location"
  scope_id   = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `scope_id` (Number) Positive scope ID.
- `scope_type` (String) resource or location.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String, Sensitive) Latest Markdown content, or null when no version exists.
- `id` (String) scope_type:scope_id.
- `version` (Number) Latest version number; zero when no version exists.

## Scope and content

| `scope_type` | `scope_id` |
|---|---|
| `resource` | Network resource ID |
| `location` | Location ID |

Requires `app.notes.read` plus read access to the scope. This lookup reads only
the latest Markdown version and never acquires locks. A scope with no note
returns null `content` and version `0`. A missing or inaccessible scope produces
an error. Note content is sensitive but persists in Terraform state.
